applies_to: UAS specific category operations using SORA (binding where a national authority/EASA AMC requires SORA)

requirement_paraphrase: OSO#24 (UAS designed and qualified for adverse environmental conditions) is not required at SAIL I-II, Medium at SAIL III, High at SAIL IV-VI.

Robustness is the combination of integrity and assurance and equals the lower of the two (Table 1). Low assurance is a declaration by the applicant; medium needs supporting evidence, typically testing or operational data; high needs verification by a competent third party.

Guidance (4.2.4): when determining the operational volume the applicant should consider position keeping in 4D, including accuracy of the navigation solution, flight technical error, path definition (map) error and latencies.
Recommends not relying only on GNSS, cross-checking with other navigation sources, assessing interference likelihood on planned and diversion routes and having backup plans.
